title: The Stars My Destination
author: Alfred Bester
summary: In a future where people teleport by thought, Gully Foyle is left for dead on a wrecked spaceship. He sets out to take revenge on the crew that abandoned him, and becomes more than he intended.
readIf: you like classic science fiction with a ruthless antihero and inventive ideas.
skipIf: you want gentle, modern character-driven fiction.
